description: This file provides an in-memory implementation of the ProfileDao interface, managing ProfileEntity objects with flow-based observation, supporting insertion, deletion, and retrieval operations. It is mainly used as a lightweight fallback for profile data management.

classes.name: InMemoryProfileDao
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of ProfileDao that stores profile entities and exposes changes via a flow.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a cold Flow emitting a list of all profile entities, ordered with newest first.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a profile entity, assigning an id if necessary, and prepends it to the list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a profile entity based on its id.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a profile by its id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by id, or null if not found.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all stored profiles and resets the id counter.
